name: diag_pilot_T0_retry4_first_update_01
command:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
p=Path('logs/runs/smoke_e2e_pilot_T0_s0_01_retry4/ppo/update_001.jsonl')
raw=p.read_bytes()
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.splitlines() if x.strip()]
selected=[r for r in rows if r.get('record_kind') in ('actual_actor_consistency_update','pilot_update_complete','pilot_update_failed')]
assert any(r.get('record_kind')=='pilot_update_complete' and r.get('update')==1 and r.get('actual_completed_updates')==1 for r in selected),'No complete original update1'
assert not any(r.get('record_kind')=='pilot_update_failed' for r in selected),'Original update failed'
print(json.dumps({'original_journal':{'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw)},'records':selected,'scope':'original completed update1 records only; parent still active, not full pilot acceptance'},sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
